sources.entry: myTinyTodo - Simple way to manage your todo list in AJAX style. Uses PHP, jQuery, SQLite/MySQL. GTD compliant. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: myTinyTodo is a lightweight, self-hosted to-do list web app written in PHP with an AJAX-style browser interface, backed by SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, or PostgreSQL.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and covers only system requirements, not features in depth. It describes myTinyTodo as "your tiny todo list" with a link to an original website (URL not included in the README text). The listing metadata describes it as an AJAX-style todo manager using PHP and jQuery, that is GTD compliant, and that is listed on awesome-selfhosted. The README lists supported databases (SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL) and supported browsers (Chrome 49, Safari 10, Firefox 53). No installation steps or usage instructions are given in the README.
use_cases: shared team task list on a web server
simple browser-based todo app with a SQL database
stack: mbstring, pdo_sqlite, intl, pdo_mysql/mysqli, pdo_pgsql PHP extensions
notable: Choice of SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, or PostgreSQL backend
Described as GTD compliant in the listing metadata
Runs on a standard PHP web server stack
caveats: Requires PHP 7.4 or greater with several extensions, and a database server unless using SQLite
Supported browsers are limited to older minimum versions; Internet Explorer and Opera (Presto) are not supported
keywords: todo list on my own server
